integrity_notes: The proof is self-contained except for classical Dilworth chain decomposition. The attached exhaustive check of naturally labeled posets up to six elements corroborates but does not certify the all-order statement; all infinite claims follow from explicit proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only Boolean vertex-membership indicators of lower ideals of finite posets. The uniqueness result applies at exact threshold order; larger extremizers and connected extremizer isomorphism types are not classified. Full historical priority cannot be guaranteed.
title: Sharp width-controlled online-shattering thresholds for finite poset ideals
